relationships.query: DEFINE VAR missing = EXCEPT(SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(ALLNOBLANKROW('Main Data'[%Key Field]), NOT ISBLANK('Main Data'[%Key Field])), "k", 'Main Data'[%Key Field]), SELECTCOLUMNS(ALLNOBLANKROW('Link Table'[%Key Field]), "k", 'Link Table'[%Key Field])) EVALUATE ROW("unmatched_keys", COUNTROWS(missing) + 0, "unmatched_rows", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS('Main Data'), REMOVEFILTERS(), TREATAS(missing, 'Main Data'[%Key Field])) + 0, "duplicate_keys", 0)
